description: This Java class `LogWrapper` implements the `LogNode` interface to wrap Android's native logging utility, providing a way to chain log nodes and output logs with additional processing if needed. It facilitates logging with optional exception details and chains to subsequent log nodes.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native Log utility to implement a chainable logging node, forwarding log messages to the next node if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which log data will be forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with specified priority, tag, and optional throwable; then forwards the log to the next node if available.
